title: 第一卷 第13章 红衣少女第一卷 第14章 万古不败龙体
content_zh:
“噗嗤……！”
叶寒一大口逆血喷涌，五脏六腑被大力贯穿，身躯要爆炸了。
差距太大了！
陆云霄此人，根本就不是之前杀死的李凯能比肩的。
“小杂种，我废了你！”
陆云霄强忍着手掌割裂的剧痛，猛然一步踏出，大地震动。
他的身躯宛若瞬移，直接出现在叶寒面前，一掌轰出，叶寒挣扎站起的身躯被狠狠震飞，逆血再度涌出。
陆云霄的一掌之间，整整三道神力轰入了叶寒体内。
这一刹那，叶寒的元力因三道神力的震击而直接溃散，气海之中，只剩不到一成的元力被死死压制。
三道神力游走于叶寒的经脉之间，冲击着他的身躯，肉身撕裂般的剧痛让叶寒一时间无法挣扎，几乎晕厥当场。
叶寒躺在地上，将喉咙涌上的逆血努力吞下去，急忙九天御龙决恢复元力，凶狠的眼神盯着陆云霄。
肆无忌惮，无法无天，生杀予夺，一念之间！
这就是轮回书院的弟子？
“住手！”
就在陆云霄再度迈步时，一道清朗的声音突然传来。
叶寒目光立刻转移过去，便看到一个身穿红色长衫，约莫和自己年龄相仿的少女怒气冲冲跑来。
看清面容凶戾的陆云霄，她不禁缩了缩脖子，声音凭空弱了几分：“你……你怎么能打人呢？”
“你不许动他！”
红衣少女明眸皓齿，肌肤胜雪，顿时展开手臂，要将叶寒护着，努力地做到和陆云霄对视。
静静看着这一幕，叶寒内心一颤。

“打人？我还要废了他！”
陆云霄面容狠厉，如同看白痴般扫视红衣少女：“滚开！”
这红衣少女不过聚元境八重天罢了！
这种聚元境的蝼蚁，比叶寒都弱小，敢阻拦他陆云霄出手？
这不是找死，还是什么？
“我不！”
少女斩钉截铁，面容坚毅。
陆云霄的一掌轰出，面目狰狞：“那就陪这小子一起死！”
“快让开。”
叶寒不知哪来的劲，猛然翻身起来，抓起少女的胳膊扯到身后，强行挡在面前。
人非草木孰能无情，叶寒不可能看着这样一个善良的女孩因自己而死。
他被叶家捡来，义父与那叶芷萱虚情假意伪装多年，最终将他废掉，不管曾经多痛苦，但他的心，还是热的。
轰！
陆云霄掌力无情，灭绝生机，乃至真正的杀招。
生死只在一瞬间！
在这万分之一个刹那，叶寒整个人突然冷静下来，无情的双目凝视前方，锁定那一道手掌。
他的思维，他的意识，达到了空前般的空灵状态，天地内的一切都如同化作虚无，在叶寒眼中只剩下那一道狂暴轰来的手掌。
嗡……！
叶寒气海深处被压制的元力终于能够调动。
他极力运转九天御龙诀，借助最后一点元力，沟通到了体内的九界镇龙塔。

无穷的压力覆盖下，叶寒终于强行打开镇龙塔，一滴纯粹至极的五爪金龙气息散逸了出来。
是的，只有一滴，瞬间融入叶寒四肢百骸。
但这一滴却是龙气不断压缩，不断凝聚后的纯粹金龙气，已经达到了液态化。
content_en:
"Pfft...!"
Ye Han's blood spurted out, his internal organs were penetrated so hard that his body was about to explode.
The gap is too big!
Lu Yunxiao is simply not comparable to the Li Kai who was killed before.
"You little bastard, I will destroy you!"
Lu Yunxiao endured the severe pain of his palm being cut, and suddenly took a step forward, causing the earth to shake.
His body seemed to teleport and appeared directly in front of Ye Han. He blasted out a palm. Ye Han's struggling body was severely knocked away, and blood flowed out again.
With one palm of Lu Yunxiao's hand, three rays of divine power blasted into Ye Han's body.
At this moment, Ye Han's Yuan Power was directly shattered by the shock of three divine powers. In the sea of ​​qi, less than 10% of his Yuan Power was tightly suppressed.
Three rays of divine power wandered between Ye Han's meridians, impacting his body. The severe pain like tearing his body made Ye Han unable to struggle for a while, and he almost fainted on the spot.
Ye Han lay on the ground, trying hard to swallow the blood that surged up in his throat, and hurriedly used the Nine Heavens Dragon Control Technique to restore his energy, staring at Lu Yunxiao with fierce eyes.
Unscrupulous, lawless, taking life and death, all in one thought!
Is this a disciple of Samsara Academy?
"Stop!"
Just when Lu Yunxiao took another step, a clear voice suddenly came.
Ye Han immediately shifted his gaze and saw a girl in a red gown, about the same age as himself, running angrily.
Seeing the ferocious-looking Lu Yunxiao, she couldn't help but shrink her neck, and her voice became a little softer: "You...how can you hit someone?"
"Don't touch him!"
The girl in red had bright eyes and white teeth, and her skin was as good as snow. She immediately spread her arms to protect Ye Han and tried her best to make eye contact with Lu Yunxiao.
Watching this scene quietly, Ye Han trembled in his heart.
"Hit someone? I'm going to destroy him!"
Lu Yunxiao looked at the girl in red with a stern expression, as if looking at an idiot: "Get away!"
This girl in red is nothing more than the eighth level of Juyuan Realm!
This kind of ant in the Juyuan realm is weaker than Ye Han. How dare he stop Lu Yunxiao from taking action?
Isn’t this seeking death, or what?
"I don't!"
The girl was determined and had a resolute face.
Lu Yunxiao struck out with a palm, his face ferocious: "Then die with this kid!"
"Get out of the way."
Ye Han didn't know where the energy came from, he suddenly turned over, grabbed the girl's arm and pulled it behind him, forcing it in front of him.
People are not as ruthless as grass and trees. Ye Han couldn't possibly watch such a kind girl die because of him.
He was picked up by the Ye family. His adoptive father and Ye Zhixuan had been pretending to be in love for many years, and finally destroyed him. No matter how painful it was, his heart was still warm.
boom!
Lu Yunxiao's palm power was ruthless, extinguishing vitality, and even a real killing move.
Life and death only happen in a moment!
At this ten thousandth of a second, Ye Han suddenly calmed down, staring ruthlessly forward, locking on that palm.
His thinking and consciousness reached an unprecedented ethereal state. Everything in the world seemed to turn into nothingness. In Ye Han's eyes, only the violently blasting palm remained.
Buzz…!
Ye Han's suppressed Yuan Power in the depths of the Qi Sea was finally able to mobilize.
He tried his best to use the Nine Heavens Dragon Control Technique, and with the help of his last bit of energy, he communicated with the Nine Realms Dragon Suppressing Tower in his body.
Under the endless pressure, Ye Han finally forced open the Dragon Suppression Tower, and a drop of pure five-clawed golden dragon breath escaped.
Yes, there was only one drop, which instantly blended into Ye Han's limbs and bones.
But this drop is the pure golden dragon energy that has been continuously compressed and condensed, and has reached a liquid state.
